notes.title: Volcano Bytes Returns – Trasmoz Legends Launches Soon on Steam!
notes.content:
[p]🎉 Great news for all retro arcade fans!
[/p][p]Solo developer [b]Volcano Bytes[/b] is back with his latest 8-bit adventure: [i]Trasmoz Legends[/i] is coming to [b]Steam on September 11th[/b]!
[/p][p]Get ready for an intense arcade experience featuring pixel-perfect visuals, a YM2203-powered chiptune soundtrack, multiple game modes, and non-stop action.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2862210?utm_source=steamevent&utm_campaign=release&utm_medium=eventgalactic"][/dynamiclink]
[/p][p]📺 Watch the trailer and add it to your wishlist now!
[/p][previewyoutube="pWNvx5Hu1kE;full"][/previewyoutube]
